Market today:
The market's feeling a bit wobbly with "rate chaos" and only a few stocks doing the heavy lifting. But falling Treasury yields ahead of FOMC minutes could offer some relief for your tech and chip names.

Your holdings:
SOXL is a big concern, down nearly 27% and flagged "SELL." SPAL is also down over 13% and leveraged. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. Your CRWD and METU gains are strong, but METU is leveraged.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on the FOMC minutes for rate direction and how your leveraged ETFs react to market shifts.

Bottom line:
Prioritize managing your leveraged losers and protecting capital in this rate-sensitive environment.
plays: Your SOXL position is down 26.91% and flagged "SELL." Re-evaluate your stop-loss immediately, as the current 200 is above the price. Consider trimming or exiting to manage margin risk.
SPAL is down 13.64% and leveraged. Respect its stop at 21.38 to limit further losses.
Your CRWD is up 55.87%. The scanner shows an "ACCUMULATE" setup at 272.29-272.02 with a stop at 271.5. This could be an opportunity to add to a winner if you're comfortable with the risk.
